<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_INQ_IP" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/inq-ip">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Request" name="Transaction data request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Data" name="Transmission of data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Rejection" name="Rejection"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_INQ_IP">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_INQ" name="INQ" processRef="Process_INQ"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IP" name="IP" processRef="Process_IP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Request" name="Transaction data request" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_IP" messageRef="Msg_Request"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Data" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="Task_TransmitData" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer" messageRef="Msg_Data"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Rejection" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Task_Reject" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer" messageRef="Msg_Rejection"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_INQ" name="INQ" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_INQ" name="Data request needed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_INQ_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitRequest" name="Transmit transaction data request" messageRef="Msg_Request">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_INQ_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_INQ_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAnswer" name="Receive answer from IP">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_INQ_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_INQ_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_INQ" name="Answer received">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_INQ_3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_INQ_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_INQ" targetRef="Task_TransmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_INQ_2" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_INQ_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer" targetRef="EndEvent_INQ"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IP" name="Transaction data request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_IP_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Request" messageRef="Msg_Request"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Check" name="Check request of INQ">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_IP_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_IP_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Examination" name="Examination outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_IP_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_IP_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_IP_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitData" name="Transmit data" messageRef="Msg_Data">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_IP_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_IP_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Reject" name="Reject request" messageRef="Msg_Rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_IP_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_IP_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IP_Data" name="Data transmitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_IP_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IP_Rejected" name="Request rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_IP_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_IP_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IP" targetRef="Task_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_IP_2" sourceRef="Task_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Examination"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_IP_3" name="Request accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_Examination" targetRef="Task_TransmitData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_IP_4" name="Request rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_Examination" targetRef="Task_Reject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_IP_5" sourceRef="Task_TransmitData" targetRef="EndEvent_IP_Data"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_IP_6" sourceRef="Task_Reject" targetRef="EndEvent_IP_Rejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
